source:
@@U01995@@
The way she drags her feet you'd think they were chained. I must confess, she seems so very like my dear good 格蕾琴.

@@U01997@@
Keep away! That’s bad news for anyone! It’s a lifeless apparition, a phantom. Nothing good can come from such a meeting. Its staring eyes can freeze a man’s blood till he’s almost turned to stone. You've heard the story of Medusa.

@@U01999@@
Yes, eyes of a dead girl not closed by a loving hand. This is the breast 格蕾琴 gave me, the sweet body I enjoyed.

@@U02001@@
It’s sorcery, you gullible fool! She appears to every man in the guise of his love.

@@U02003@@
What ecstasy! What agony! How can I tear myself from this vision! How strange that lovely throat should be adorned by one thin red thread no wider than the blade of a knife.

@@U02005@@
Right you are! I see it, too. She could just as well carry her head tucked under her arm; after all, 珀耳修斯 cut it off for her. Ah, but this hankering of yours for illusion!
translation:
@@U01995@@
她拖着脚步的样子，你会以为她的脚被锁链拴住了。我必须承认，她看起来非常像我亲爱的好格蕾琴。

@@U01997@@
远离！这对任何人来说都是坏消息！这是一个没有生命的幻影，一个幻影。这样的会议不会有什么好处。它凝视的眼睛可以冻结一个人的血液，直到他几乎变成石头。你一定听过美杜莎的故事。

@@U01999@@
是的，一个死去的女孩的眼睛没有被一只充满爱的手合上。这就是格蕾琴给我的乳房，我享受的甜美身体。

@@U02001@@
这是巫术，你这个容易受骗的傻瓜！她以爱的幌子出现在每个男人面前。

@@U02003@@
多么狂喜啊！多么痛苦啊！我怎么能从这个异象中挣脱出来呢！多么奇怪，那可爱的喉咙竟然被一根不比刀刃宽的细红线装饰着。

@@U02005@@
你是对的！我也看到了。她也可以把头夹在腋下。毕竟，珀耳修斯替她斩断了。啊，但是你对幻觉的渴望！
